title: Fixed L-Access Sector-Shelf Corner Cabinet
description: One complete original fixed L-access corner cabinet. A concave orthogonal cabinet body has two perpendicular open front mouths, complete rear and return walls, an L-shaped countertop and recessed L plinth. Two three-quarter annular sector trays with raised curved rims surround a fixed central post inside the real cavity. The two radial open tray edges face the concave access corner. This is a new whole cabinet layout rather than a diagonal-door cabinet resized or its door deleted. All trays and post are fixed static forms; no rotation, animation, continuous clearance, load rating, old-family fitting, installation or stability claim.
